_comment: What the log capture repeats across Dart, Java and Objective-C, and what the SDKs define. Compared with Dart, the Java/ObjC sources (test/logs_drift_test.dart) and the REAL SDK enums (LogWireParityTest.java, BGSFlutterLogOpsTests.m). The source is a constant of native code: the wrapper channel accepts Custom 98 (the host runtime's own logs), WebView 5, StdOut 1, StdErr 2 and Unknown 0 and records every other value as Custom; this wrapper claims only Custom, never Bugsee (4, the app's own Bugsee.log, which would also skip the app's log filter). Levels are the SDKs' LogLevel / BugseeLogLevel values (the same on both; Breadcrumb levels are not).
